summary: Source-only review of candidate tree 518ed8c4aca3babc7682d862a70079cc8aa99a7b approves integration of the DoctorWatson Task2 publication fixture. The change replaces the compile-dependent test helper in crates/mori/src/commands/compile.rs with an include_str! of an independently frozen crates/fixtures/publication/transport-artifact.json decoded through the ACTUAL production serde decoder (serde_json::from_str::<mori_backend::Artifact>), and adds one positive projection test; it does not touch any production publisher or the three original failure/order test bodies. I traced the real unsigned decode path (Artifact TryFrom<ArtifactFields> then Target::validate, version decoders, decode_digest, registry ceiling, and signed_relation::validate_shape unsigned branch) and confirm the literal fixture shapes are accepted at source. The helper imports no implementation output and no longer calls parse/compile; opaque zkir text and placeholder digests are never parsed, so only byte transport/order is exercised. Findings below are non-blocking coverage/meaningfulness gaps. All higher tiers (compile/serde/publication execution, native, financial, ledger, signing) are explicitly out of scope and UNRUN; security judgment remains with Opus.
findings: VERIFIED (not a defect): the unsigned-path serde constructor accepts the fixture at source. Artifact TryFrom (mori-backend/src/lib.rs:260): authorization_mode 'unsigned' equals target.authorization_mode() because signed_policy is OMITTED; an explicit null would instead be rejected by present_policy (lib.rs:58). program_hash (64x0) and both context_hash (64x1/64x2) pass decode_digest. validate_shape unsigned branch (signed_relation.rs:505) is satisfied: context positions 0/1 have role=context, name program_target_action.{0,1}, ty UInt, asset null, canonical decimal constants (0/1 and 2/3); authorization_bindings=[] and private_inputs=[]. Target::validate passes: pinned ledger-9, LEDGER_REVISION 04c9c5d9..., zkir_version 3.0.0-rc.2, nonempty bounded network/anchor, positive limits. Version decoders match the three exact strings. Resources: decode_registry_entries(0)<=16 and decode_registry_ceiling(16)==MAX_LIABILITY_REGISTRY_ENTRIES which is literally 16 (liabilities.rs:8). All structs are deny_unknown_fields and the fixture supplies exactly the expected keys, including the constant/asset/circuit_k/fraud_max_k keys that use Option::deserialize and therefore must be present.

VERIFIED (not a defect): helper does not synthesize or import implementation output. The new artifact() (compile.rs:131-138) uses include_str!(concat!(env!(CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR), "/../fixtures/publication/transport-artifact.json")) which from crates/mori resolves to crates/fixtures/publication/transport-artifact.json (matches SCOPE.json changedPaths), then decodes via the real serde_json::from_str::<mori_backend::Artifact>. The former mori_core::parse + mori_backend::compile + to_string_pretty path is removed; manifest m is the raw frozen file bytes.

VERIFIED (not a defect): production publisher and manifest/producer order unchanged. publish_artifact (compile.rs:71), publish_staged_artifact (compile.rs:92), run (compile.rs:18) and proof_io::publish_new are all outside the PATCH.diff hunks; the diff touches only the #[cfg(test)] helper and appends one test. publish_artifact writes circuits in enumerate order as {index:03}-{action}.zkir, then optional source-projection.json, then artifact.json as the completion marker LAST, matching the README contract. The three original tests (raced_files..., raced_symlinks..., final_manifest_follows_all_complete_ordered_circuits) are present with unchanged bodies.

MISSING MEANINGFUL EXPECTATION (non-blocking): the projection code branch has no refusal/order coverage. All three existing failure/order tests pass projection=None; the single new positive test passes Some(projection) but only asserts the final 4-file directory state and exact leaf bytes. No test exercises a collision/race on source-projection.json, and none asserts that artifact.json (the marker) is written only AFTER source-projection.json when a projection is present. The 'if let Some(projection)' leaf write in publish_artifact is therefore only exercised on the happy path.

WEAKER THAN SIBLING TEST (non-blocking): source_projection_is_published_... reads the completed directory rather than observing ordering, so it cannot detect a mis-ordered marker (unlike the no-projection final_manifest test which at least pins totals). Also the manifest leaf is asserted against m (the include_str! bytes) rather than against an independently restated byte-count/SHA; the README pins 2424 bytes / sha256 4e66f47b... but the test does not assert that size or hash, so an accidental fixture edit would silently redefine the manifest 'pass'. The projection string literal {\"transport_fixture\":\"projection\"}\n is an independent transport specimen, not implementation output.

SCOPE BOUNDARY (must stay explicit, not a code defect): the constructor and tests certify schema + byte transport ONLY. The serde TryFrom does not cross-check resources (artifact_bytes=2424, zkir_bytes=93, public_values=4, instructions=0) against the circuits, never parses the zkir strings, and the digests are literal 0/1/2 placeholders. semantics 'moriarty-core/1' and empty gates[] are stored without validation. Successful decode must NOT be read by any higher tier as compiled/native/financial/ledger validity, and this fixture must not be sent to native validation.
filesRead: (fixture README.md and transport-artifact.json read in full via the embedded PATCH.diff; byte-identical to candidate/crates/fixtures/publication/* per MANIFEST.json sha256 5d06ab32... and 4e66f47b...)
limitations: No native or build execution performed: Rust/Cargo compile, serde decode, and publication unit tests are UNRUN (consistent with SCOPE.json RustCargoDecoderPublicationTests=UNRUN). No RED/GREEN established; decode acceptance is a source-level trace of the serde path, and the helper's .unwrap() would only be proven non-panicking by actually running the tests.

Did not read mori_core (Type enum serialization 'UInt'/'Bool', AssetId, intent::canonical/hex, json::parse) nor schnorr.rs unhex internals; the review relies on their documented/behaviour-consistent contracts. mori_backend::stage is referenced by run() but not in the changed scope and was not inspected beyond its call site.
Read signed_relation.rs only through line ~1417 of 1726 (the full validate_shape and append/reconstruct paths were covered); the trailing test module was not needed for this fixture scope.

The fixture README and transport-artifact.json were examined via the full PATCH.diff content rather than the standalone candidate files; MANIFEST.json sha256 values (5d06ab32..., 4e66f47b...) were used to confirm they are the same bytes, but I did not independently recompute those hashes.

All security judgments, native/resource admission, financial/ledger/proof/signing/key/wallet acceptance are out of scope and reserved to Opus; this verdict is ordinary source and test-scope review only and does not establish product acceptance or arm any loop.
